scenarios.name: test-single-opponent-must-block
scenarios.known_bug: XP[lure-all-able-must-block-unsupported]: gorge never enforces the printed Lure keyword 'All creatures able to block CARDNAME do so.' (Shinen K: line): it is neither canonicalised (engine/cards/hiddenkeyword.go:36) nor read by the combat hidden-keyword parser, which only knows can't-attack/can't-block/must-be-blocked (engine/rules/combat/restrictions.go:41-83); transcript shows p1 blockers -> [] so Bears never block and Shinen survives. CR 509.1c.
